data.title: Vivesto’s Paccal Vet Shows Survival Benefit in Canine Hemangiosarcoma Study
data.description:
Vivesto AB ( (SE:VIVE) ) has issued an announcement.

Vivesto AB has reported positive topline results from an open-label pilot study of its veterinary cancer drug candidate Paccal Vet in dogs with Stage I-II splenic hemangiosarcoma following splenectomy. The median overall survival of 135 days exceeded surgically treated historical controls, reinforcing the efficacy signal seen in interim data and supporting progression to a pivotal registration study.

Safety in the 26-dog cohort was considered tolerable with proactive monitoring, with most side effects typical of chemotherapy and manageable, though a small number of serious adverse events occurred at higher doses. The confirmation of benefit strengthens Vivesto’s partnering prospects with Liberi Group and may pave the way toward conditional approval and earlier market entry for Paccal Vet in a canine cancer indication that currently lacks any regulatory-approved therapies.

data.title: Wynn Macau Cuts Convertible Bond Conversion Price After Interim Dividend
data.description:
An update from Wynn Macau ( (HK:1128) ) is now available.

Wynn Macau has adjusted the conversion price of its US$600 million 4.50% convertible bonds due 2029 following the declaration of an interim cash dividend of HK$0.223 per share. Under the bond terms, capital distributions trigger a formula‑based change in the conversion price, aligning bondholder economics with shareholder payouts.

The conversion price will be reduced from HK$9.02275 to HK$8.67530, effective 16 September 2026, immediately after the dividend record date. Assuming full conversion, the bonds would now be convertible into about 542.9 million shares, equivalent to roughly 10.2% of current issued share capital and 9.3% of the enlarged share base, slightly increasing potential dilution while preserving bondholders’ value.

data.title: Satellos Bioscience to Showcase Forazapadin Program at World Muscle Society Congress
data.description:
Satellos Bioscience ( (TSE:MSCL) ) has provided an announcement.

Satellos Bioscience Inc., a Toronto-based clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company listed on NASDAQ and TSX, develops small-molecule medicines targeting degenerative muscle diseases, led by its AAK1 inhibitor forazapadin for Duchenne muscular dystrophy and related conditions. The firm’s strategy centers on disease-modifying approaches to muscle repair and regeneration, supported by ongoing Phase 2 trials in pediatric and adult DMD populations and planned expansion into facioscapulohumeral muscular dystrophy.

On September 15, 2026, Satellos announced it will deliver four scientific poster presentations on its forazapadin program at the 31st Annual Congress of the World Muscle Society, taking place in Hiroshima, Japan, from September 29 to October 3, 2026. The data span Phase 2 DMD studies BASECAMP and TRAILHEAD, translational work on a regenerative index, and the design rationale for a planned FSHD study, underscoring Satellos’s effort to validate its mechanism and broaden clinical applications, which may strengthen its visibility among specialists and support long-term pipeline development.

data.title: Rocket Pharmaceuticals advances pivotal Danon disease trial
data.description:
Rocket Pharmaceuticals ( (RCKT) ) has provided an announcement.

On September 15, 2026, Rocket Pharmaceuticals announced it had reached alignment with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration on key elements of its global pivotal Phase 2 trial of RP-A501 for Danon disease, a rare inherited cardiomyopathy. The agreement covers a recalibrated dose, a 12-patient pivotal efficacy population using commercial-grade product, and established 12-month co-primary endpoints.

Initial safety data from the first three patients treated under a modified protocol showed no evidence of thrombotic microangiopathy or capillary leak syndrome, supporting continued enrollment and dosing at the new dose. The FDA’s confirmation that these first three patients count toward the pivotal 12-patient population, and that co-primary endpoints of myocardial LAMP2 expression and reduced left ventricular mass are intended to support potential accelerated approval, gives Rocket a clearer regulatory pathway as it targets completion of dosing by mid-2027.

data.title: Time Interconnect Raises Final Price for Singapore Acquisition After NAV Upside
data.description:

Time Interconnect Technology Limited has finalized the net asset value of its newly acquired subsidiary group, Time Interconnect Singapore Pte. Ltd., as at the completion date of 31 July 2026, based on IFRS-compliant accounts agreed with the vendor. The completion NAV reached about US$68.4 million, substantially higher than the initial NAV of US$24.9 million, reflecting a stronger-than-expected financial position for the target group.

As a result of this higher NAV, the consideration for the 51% stake has been adjusted upward by approximately US$22.2 million, taking the final purchase price to US$34.9 million while still below the pre-agreed cap of US$40 million. The company will settle the upward adjustment in cash by 29 September 2026 using proceeds from its recent placing, tying the acquisition financing directly to capital raised from the market and reinforcing its expansion in interconnect technology operations.
